parts.text: Aventuras de Sherlock Holmes XV\. — La cara amarilla {{#ejercicio e:holmes q:ejercicio|[[holmes|Sherlock Holmes]] era hombre que rara vez hacía ejercicio por el ejercicio mismo.}} {{#primavera q:primavera|Un día, a comienzos de la primavera, había llegado a relajarse tanto que salió conmigo a dar un paseo por el parque, donde los primeros brotes verdes asomaban ya en los olmos.}} {{#cinco p:baker_street q:cinco|Eran casi las cinco cuando volvimos a estar en [[baker_street|Baker Street]].}} {{#botones q:botones|—Perdone, señor —dijo nuestro botones al abrirnos la puerta—.}} Ha estado aquí un caballero preguntando por usted, señor. —¡Vaya! {{#pipa e:holmes q:pipa|Esa [[pipa|pipa]] de la mesa no es la de usted.}} El caballero debe de haberse olvidado la suya. {{#ambar q:ambar|Una buena pipa vieja de brezo, con una boquilla larga de lo que los estanqueros llaman ámbar.}} {{#zurdo e:holmes q:zurdo|—El dueño es evidentemente un hombre musculoso, zurdo, de dentadura excelente, descuidado en sus costumbres y que no tiene necesidad de economizar.}}

src_en.ejercicio: Sherlock Holmes was a man who seldom took exercise for exercise’s sake.
src_en.primavera: One day in early spring he had so far relaxed as to go for a walk with me in the Park, where the first faint shoots of green were breaking out upon the elms
src_en.cinco: It was nearly five before we were back in Baker Street once more.
src_en.botones: Beg pardon, sir,” said our page-boy, as he opened the door.
src_en.pipa: That’s not your pipe on the table.
src_en.ambar: A nice old briar with a good long stem of what the tobacconists call amber.
src_en.zurdo: The owner is obviously a muscular man, left-handed, with an excellent set of teeth, careless in his habits, and with no need to practise economy.
src_en.escalofrio: I don’t know what there was about that face, Mr. Holmes, but it seemed to send a chill right down my back.
src_en.inhumano: I was some little way off, so that I could not make out the features, but there was something unnatural and inhuman about the face.
src_en.arrancada: But as I did so the face suddenly disappeared, so suddenly that it seemed to have been plucked away into the darkness of the room.
src_en.londres: I think,” said he, “that we shall be of more use in London than in Norbury.
src_en.vela: Not another word did he say of the case until late that night, when he was turning away, with his lighted candle, for his bedroom.
src_en.norbury: Watson,” said he, “if it should ever strike you that I am getting a little over-confident in my powers, or giving less pains to a case than it deserves, kindly whisper ‘Norbury’ in my ear, and I shall be infinitely obliged to you.
